judgmentswitch-not-checkbox: The control is a native `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">` visually restyled as a toggle inside a span. The diff's own comment says 'Acme DS has no Switch/Toggle component yet, so this is built from a native checkbox.' The change therefore does not use a system on/off switch control; it hand-builds one on top of a checkbox. The ARIA role and visual treatment get partial credit, but the underlying control is the checkbox the rubric excludes.n/a
judgmentlabel-description: Each setting renders a title span (Email digests / Push alerts / Product announcements) and a secondary description span, linked to the control via aria-labelledby and aria-describedby. That satisfies the title-plus-description shape. However, the rubric also requires following the system's settings-row pattern, and the diff contains no reference to any system settings-row component or documented pattern. It builds its own row with inline flex styles, so conformance to the system pattern cannot be verified and is not clearly met.n/a
judgmentsystem-layout: The section, list, and row are laid out with inline `style` objects using flexbox and `var(--space-*)` gap and padding tokens. Spacing does use design tokens, but the grouping is ad-hoc: there is no import or use of system layout primitives (e.g., Stack, Box, Inline, Grid). The rubric asks for system primitives rather than ad-hoc layout, so this fails.n/a
